scope: Free-text searches for evidence across Article 20-adjacent monitoring topics. The original pilot questions and legal commencement case are excluded.

queries.query: Snow cover extent and persistence in the European Alps
queries.intent: Find a satellite-derived snow cover product with repeated observations that cover the European Alps. Weather station records and snow depth without spatial extent may provide supporting context.

queries.query: Maps of soil organic carbon stocks in European cropland mineral topsoil
queries.intent: Find spatial data that estimate stocks of soil organic carbon in mineral cropland topsoil. Check the region and whether the product estimates a stock or provides only a related variable.

queries.query: Map canopy loss from insect outbreaks in European conifer forests
queries.intent: Find mapped canopy loss or disturbance observations tied to insect damage in European conifer forests. General forest cover or canopy disturbance with no cause information can be useful context.

queries.query: Repeated lake surface water temperature observations in Scandinavia during 2020
queries.intent: Find a product that measures lake surface water temperature repeatedly in Scandinavia and covers the requested year. Lake area, sea temperature and air temperature are different measurements.

queries.query: Measuring oxygen concentration in the atmosphere of Jupiter’s moon Europa
queries.intent: Check whether a terrestrial catalogue offers irrelevant matches for a planetary question. A useful candidate needs a specific connection to atmospheric oxygen observations for Europa.

queries.query: Using acoustic surveys to track breeding farmland birds on European farms
queries.intent: Find a project that uses or evaluates sound recordings to monitor breeding farmland birds in Europe. A project about general farm biodiversity needs evidence about the survey method or birds to qualify as useful.

queries.query: Testing remote sensing methods for mapping standing and fallen deadwood in forests
queries.intent: Find a project that develops or tests remote sensing of standing or fallen deadwood. General forest structure sensing can be supporting context if the method can be linked to deadwood measurements.

queries.query: Methods to measure soil erosion from rainfall in Mediterranean vineyards
queries.intent: Find a project that measures or models rain-driven soil erosion in vineyards under Mediterranean conditions. Broad agricultural sustainability work needs a transferable erosion measurement or comparable trial.

queries.query: Mapping submerged seagrass meadow extent from underwater or satellite imagery
queries.intent: Find a project that uses underwater or satellite imagery to map seagrass meadow extent. Restoration research can provide context if its methods address seagrass distribution.

queries.query: Standardized monitoring of freshwater fish communities using environmental DNA
queries.intent: Find a project that uses or validates environmental DNA to monitor freshwater fish communities. Research on eDNA methods or freshwater fish survey protocols may offer transferable evidence.
